questions.prompt: Votre direction prépare une réunion sur le plan de cybersécurité. Rédigez une note pour des responsables non spécialistes. Expliquez sur quelles informations fonder le plan, qui l’approuve et comment organiser son suivi.
questions.passage: Synthèse de travail des articles 4, 6 à 9 du règlement (UE, Euratom) 2023/2841, pages 11 à 14 du PDF distribué par EPSO. Chaque entité organise la gouvernance des risques de cybersécurité dans un cadre interne. Elle examine son degré de maturité et choisit des mesures techniques, opérationnelles et organisationnelles adaptées aux risques. La direction approuve un plan fondé sur cette évaluation, les actifs concernés et les risques identifiés. Ce plan inclut la réponse aux crises majeures. Il est transmis au conseil interinstitutionnel de cybersécurité et fait l’objet d’une révision tous les deux ans, ou plus fréquemment si nécessaire. Les informations personnelles traitées ou échangées dans ce cadre sont limitées aux besoins de la mission.

translations.Un détecteur signale 40 dossiers, dont 3: A detector flags 40 files, of which 30 are actually irregular. Ten further irregularities go undetected. What is its precision (positive predictive value)?
translations.La précision divise les vrais positifs p: Precision is the proportion of flags that are true positives: 30 out of 40.
translations.Documentation primaire de l’organisme ou: Primary documentation from the organisation or project concerned.
translations.Sur 80 fraudes confirmées, un système en: Of 80 confirmed fraud cases, a system detects 52. It also raises 13 false alarms. What is its recall?
translations.Le rappel mesure les fraudes détectées p: Recall divides the frauds detected by all actual frauds: 52/80 = 0.65.
The observed values are 8, 12 and 16. The corresponding predictions are 6, 15 and 15. What is the mean absolute error?
translations.Les écarts absolus valent 2, 3 et 1. Leu: The absolute errors are 2, 3 and 1. Their average is 2.
translations.Cinq délais en minutes sont 18, 2, 5, 35: Five processing times in minutes are 18, 2, 5, 35 and 10. Which median should be reported?
translations.La série triée est 2, 5, 10, 18, 35. Sa: In ascending order the times are 2, 5, 10, 18 and 35. The third value is 10.
translations.La colonne montant contient successiveme: The montant column contains 12, NULL, 12 and 18. What does SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT montant) FROM achats return?
translations.COUNT écarte NULL et DISTINCT conserve u: COUNT excludes NULL and DISTINCT keeps one occurrence each of 12 and 18.
Table A contains the keys 1, 2 and 3. Table B contains the keys 2, 2 and 4. How many rows does A LEFT JOIN B ON A.k = B.k produce?
translations.Les clés 1 et 3 donnent une ligne chacun: Keys 1 and 3 each produce one row. The two matches for key 2 produce two more.
translations.Deux erreurs de prédiction, en unités de: Two prediction errors, in the units of measurement, are −2 and 4. What is the mean squared error?
translations.Les carrés valent 4 et 16. Leur moyenne: The squared errors are 4 and 16. Their average is 10.
translations.Un premier service traite 20 dossiers en: One service processes 20 files at 4 minutes each. Another processes 80 files at 9 minutes each. What is the mean time per file?
translations.Le temps total vaut 20 × 4 + 80 × 9 = 80: Total time is 20 × 4 + 80 × 9 = 800 minutes for 100 files.
translations.Parmi 120 dossiers réellement conformes,: Of 120 genuinely compliant files, 18 trigger a false alarm. What is the specificity?
translations.La spécificité est la proportion de vrai: Specificity is the proportion of true negatives among actual negatives: 102/120.
translations.Une table contient les codes A, A, A, B,: A table contains the codes A, A, A, B, C, C. How many rows does SELECT code FROM t GROUP BY code HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 return?
translations.A et C satisfont la condition sur le gro: Groups A and C satisfy the condition.
translations.Dans un sous-réseau IPv4 /27 classique,: In a conventional /27 IPv4 subnet, how many addresses can be assigned after reserving the network and broadcast addresses?
Five host bits give 32 addresses. Reserving two leaves 30.
translations.Les blocs /26 commencent aux multiples d: The /26 blocks begin at multiples of 64. Address 141 lies in the 128–191 block.
translations.Sur un lien utile constant de 80 Mbit/s,: At a constant effective rate of 80 Mbit/s, how many seconds does it take to transfer 300 decimal MB, ignoring overhead?
translations.300 Mo correspondent à 2 400 Mbit. La du: 300 MB equals 2,400 Mbit. Transfer time is 2,400/80 seconds.
translations.Référence primaire pour les unités. Le s: Primary reference for measurement units. The scenario and data were created for this exercise.
translations.Une grappe offre 48 To bruts. Chaque blo: A cluster has 48 TB of raw capacity. Each block is stored three times in total. With no other overhead, how much logical data can it hold?
translations.Chaque To logique consomme 3 To bruts. L: Each logical TB consumes 3 raw TB. Logical capacity is 48/3.

translations.Un service est indisponible 36 minutes p: A service is unavailable for 36 minutes during a 6,000-minute observation period. What availability was observed?
translations.Le service est disponible 5 964 minutes: It was available for 5,964 out of 6,000 minutes, or 99.4%.
translations.Un instantané cohérent est achevé à 08 h: One consistent snapshot finishes at 08:15 and the next at 09:15. A failure occurs at 09:02. How much change history will be lost when the last completed snapshot is restored?
translations.Le dernier instantané achevé date de 08: The last completed snapshot is from 08:15. The interval to 09:02 is 47 minutes.
translations.Chaque hôte peut servir 180 requêtes/s a: Each host can handle 180 requests/s at the required service level. With perfect load balancing, how many identical hosts are needed to serve 600 requests/s after losing one host?
translations.Quatre hôtes survivants couvrent la char: Four surviving hosts can handle 720 requests/s. A fifth is needed to tolerate one failure.
translations.Énoncé autonome — capacité garantie par: Self-contained problem — guaranteed capacity per host.
translations.Quelle est l’adresse de diffusion du rés: What is the broadcast address of the 198.51.100.64/28 network?
translations.Les 16 adresses vont de .64 à .79 inclus: The 16 addresses run from .64 to .79 inclusive. The last one is the broadcast address.
translations.Le journal produit 250 Mo décimaux par h: A log produces 250 decimal MB per hour. How much storage does 72 hours require without compression?
translations.Combien de préfixes /64 distincts peut-o: How many distinct /64 prefixes fit in an IPv6 /60 prefix?
translations.Le découpage libère quatre bits de sous-: Four additional subnet bits give 2 to the power of 4 possible prefixes.

translations.La dérivation relie deux entités. La gén: Derivation links two entities. Generation links an entity to an activity, whereas usage starts from an activity.
translations.Un thésaurus décrit un concept dans troi: A thesaurus describes a concept in three languages. How should its preferred French, German and English labels be published in SKOS?
translations.Déclarer trois skos:prefLabel de langue: Declare three French skos:prefLabel values on the concept.
translations.Créer trois collections ordonnées de con: Create three ordered concept collections to represent the translations.
translations.Porter trois skos:prefLabel sur le même: Attach three skos:prefLabel values to the same concept with distinct language tags.
translations.Un concept peut porter un libellé préfér: SKOS allows one preferred label per language on a concept. Language tags distinguish the labels.
translations.Le portail diffuse exactement les mêmes: A portal distributes exactly the same observations as CSV and JSON. In DCAT, how can each format and its URL be described?
translations.Un dcat:Dataset relié à deux dcat:Distri: One dcat:Dataset linked to two dcat:Distribution resources.
translations.Deux dcat:CatalogRecord qui représentent: Two dcat:CatalogRecord resources representing the binary formats.
translations.Un dcat:DataService distinct pour chaque: A separate dcat:DataService for every table column.
translations.Deux dcat:DatasetSeries dont chacune rep: Two dcat:DatasetSeries resources, each representing a file extension.
translations.Une distribution décrit une forme access: The dataset is the common resource. A distribution describes one accessible representation.
translations.Une forme SHACL cible tous les dossiers: A SHACL shape targets every RDF case file. Its owner type check passes even when the owner property is absent. Which constraint makes the property mandatory?
translations.La cardinalité minimale vérifie qu’au mo: Minimum cardinality requires at least one value. Type constraints alone apply to the values that exist.
translations.Des institutions partenaires envoient ch: Partner institutions each submit multiple observations. The future model will be used on entirely new institutions. Which split directly tests this situation?
translations.Tirer des lignes au hasard dans chaque i: Randomly assign rows from each institution to every fold.
translations.Utiliser les institutions dans tous les: Include each institution in all folds and vary only the random seed.
translations.Réserver des institutions entières à cha: Hold out entire institutions for each validation fold.
translations.Ordonner les lignes par identifiant, pui: Sort rows by identifier, then alternate between training and validation.
translations.Garder les groupes disjoints mesure la g: Holding out institutions prevents information from the same institution from appearing on both sides of the split.
translations.Vous allez prévoir chaque mois les entré: Each month you will forecast next month's arrivals using completed months. The observations are equally spaced. Which backtest respects the availability of data?
translations.Avancer la date de coupure et entraîner: Advance the cutoff date and train each model only on months preceding the month evaluated.
translations.Former des plis aléatoires stratifiés pa: Create random folds stratified by year.
translations.Entraîner sur l’année la plus récente pu: Train on the most recent year, then predict earlier months.
translations.Mélanger les mois avant de construire ch: Shuffle the months before forming each training window.
translations.Une évaluation chronologique reproduit l: Each forecast must use only information available at its prediction date.
translations.Une équipe réalise une validation croisé: A team runs cross-validation after imputing missing values with the mean of all rows. Which change keeps the validation folds independent?
translations.Calculer une moyenne commune avec les ci: Compute a shared mean using the targets from every fold.
translations.Imputer chaque pli de validation avec la: Impute each validation fold using its own mean to reproduce an individual prediction.
translations.Augmenter le nombre de plis en conservan: Increase the number of folds while retaining the initial imputation.
translations.Estimer la moyenne dans le pli d’apprent: Estimate the mean on the training fold and apply it to the validation fold.
translations.Le paramètre du prétraitement doit être: Fitting the imputer on training data prevents information from the validation fold entering preprocessing.
translations.Un modèle fournit des probabilités de re: A model produces delay probabilities used to estimate provisions for case files. Which check directly evaluates the calibration of these probabilities?
translations.Comparer seulement l’ordre des scores en: Compare only the ranking of scores for delayed and on-time files.
translations.Mesurer uniquement le nombre de variable: Measure only the number of variables in the model.
translations.Comparer, par plage de probabilités, la: Compare the mean prediction with the observed delay frequency within probability bins on held-out data.
translations.Comparer uniquement l’exactitude des cla: Compare only classification accuracy after applying a 50% threshold.
translations.La calibration porte sur l’accord entre: Calibration compares predicted probabilities with observed frequencies, independently of a particular decision threshold.
translations.Une jointure Spark est lente. Quelques p: A Spark join is slow. A few shuffle partitions contain nearly all rows because one key is very common. Which AQE mechanism directly targets the imbalance?
translations.Fusionner toutes les partitions de sorti: Merge all output partitions into one file.
translations.Scinder les partitions de jointure déséq: Split skewed join partitions and replicate corresponding data where needed.
translations.Supprimer les statistiques de taille des: Discard partition-size statistics after the shuffle.
translations.Trier seulement les fichiers de résultat: Sort only the result files by name before publishing.
translations.L’optimisation des jointures asymétrique: Skew join optimisation splits oversized partitions so that several tasks share the work.
translations.Une table de faits très volumineuse doit: A very large fact table must be equi-joined with a small lookup table that easily fits in memory on each Spark executor. Which plan can avoid shuffling the fact table for this join?
translations.Diffuser la table de faits à tous les ex: Broadcast the fact table to every executor.
translations.Collecter la table de faits sur le pilot: Collect the fact table on the driver before joining.
translations.Diffuser le dictionnaire sur les exécute: Broadcast the lookup table to the executors and perform the lookups locally.
translations.Repartitionner les deux entrées sur une: Repartition both inputs on a random key unrelated to the join key.
translations.La table diffusée étant disponible sur c: A broadcast join distributes the small side so executors can match their local rows.
translations.À l’import de subventions, tout identifi: When grants are imported, every programme ID supplied must exist in the programmes table. Which constraint checks this relationship on each write?
translations.Une contrainte UNIQUE sur le montant de: A UNIQUE constraint on the grant amount.
translations.Un index simple sur l’identifiant du pro: An ordinary index on programme ID in the grants table.
translations.Une contrainte NOT NULL sur le libellé d: A NOT NULL constraint on the programme name.
translations.Une clé étrangère vers la clé du program: A foreign key referencing the programme key.
translations.La clé étrangère compare la référence av: A foreign key enforces the existence of the referenced value. Indexes on their own do not enforce this relationship.
translations.Dans PostgreSQL, une colonne montant nul: In PostgreSQL, the nullable montant column has only CHECK (montant >= 0). Publication requires a value that is present and non-negative. What is missing?
A NOT NULL constraint on montant.
translations.Un changement du nom du CHECK pour inclu: Renaming the CHECK to include the word mandatory.
translations.Le CHECK accepte le résultat inconnu pro: A CHECK permits an unknown result for NULL. NOT NULL separately enforces presence.
translations.Deux équipes modifient la même fiche via: Two teams edit the same record through an API supporting conditional requests and strong ETags. How can the second writer avoid overwriting an update made since its read?
translations.Répéter la modification avec un délai fi: Repeat the update after a fixed delay on success.
translations.Envoyer If-None-Match: * pour modifier u: Send If-None-Match: * to modify only an existing record.
translations.Envoyer l’ETag lu dans If-Match avec la: Send the ETag obtained when reading in If-Match on the update.
translations.If-Match conditionne l’écriture à la cor: If-Match makes the write conditional on the resource still matching the version the client read.
translations.Une sonde réémet deux fois une requête P: A probe retries an identical PUT request that sets a resource's entire configuration. In HTTP, what does idempotence mean for this operation?
translations.Le serveur doit répondre avec exactement: The server must return exactly the same bytes every time.
translations.L’effet demandé sur la ressource est le: The requested effect on the resource is the same as after one PUT.
translations.Le second appel doit obligatoirement rec: The second call must return status 304.
translations.Le serveur doit dédupliquer toutes les t: The server must deduplicate all access logs for both requests.
translations.L’idempotence porte sur l’effet intentio: Idempotence concerns the intended effect on resource state. Responses and access logs may differ.
translations.Un service de recherche doit accepter un: A search service must accept a common abbreviation while keeping the full name as its preferred French label. How should the abbreviation be represented in SKOS?
translations.Remplacer le libellé préféré par le seul: Replace the preferred label with the technical ID alone.
translations.Créer une relation skos:narrower vers le: Create a skos:narrower relationship to the full name.
translations.L’ajouter en skos:altLabel au concept ex: Add it as a skos:altLabel on the existing concept.
translations.Ajouter un second skos:prefLabel françai: Add a second French skos:prefLabel to the same concept.
translations.Le libellé alternatif rattache une varia: An alternative label provides another lexical form of the same concept while preserving the preferred label.
translations.Un audit demande quel traitement a produ: An auditor asks which computation produced a published indicator version. Which PROV-O arc points from the published entity to the calculation activity?
translations.Une génération met en relation l’entité: prov:wasGeneratedBy links a generated entity to the activity responsible for it.
translations.Un catalogue souhaite décrire le service: A catalogue describes an HTTP service through which analysts can query several datasets, including its endpoint. Which DCAT class represents the service itself?
translations.DataService représente un service fourni: dcat:DataService represents a service providing data access. Its endpoint can be described on that resource.
